sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 spans three model scales: 397B MoE, 35B MoE and 9B dense. Designed for strong general-purpose intelligence across reasoning, agentic, and coding tasks, Ornith-1.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable size across a broad range of benchmarks.

sources.title: DeepReinforce Ornith-1.5 family released - NVIDIA Developer Forums
sources.snippet: Looks like DeepReinforce released a bunch of Ornith-1.5 models today: 9B, 35B-A3B, 397B in a nice mix of quants/formats. The 35B-A3B looks interesting for a single-node setup. Downloading on one of my GX10s to give it a run through. Anyone already give it a go? Text-only per the model card, so not a direct competitor/replacement for Qwen3.6-35B, perhaps.
